title: Alex Warren to Perform at Irving Plaza for SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series Concert
summary: Alex Warren will perform at New York City's Irving Plaza for the latest SiriusXM Small Stage Series concert presented by REESE'S.
body_markdown:
[Alex Warren](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/alex-warren) is treating fans to an intimate concert with SiriusXM.


The pop sensation will take the stage at New York City’s Irving Plaza for the latest installment of SiriusXM’s[Small Stage Series](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/small-stage-series) , presented by REESE’S, on December 10. Alex will perform songs from his latest album *WILDCHILD* and more of his chart-topping hits in an intimate setting.


[SiriusXM Hits 1 Pop hits, now to next Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAlexWarrenSmallStageSeries)


For fans who can’t make it, the full concert will air on SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2) on December 17, 18, 19, and 20. On Friday, December 18, select songs will air on The Pulse, Mosaic, Unwell Music and The Coffee House, and will be available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAlexWarrenSmallStageSeries) afterwards.


### Enter for a Chance to Win Tickets to Alex Warren’s Small Stage Series Concert in NYC


Want a chance to attend Alex’s *Small Stage Series* concert in NYC presented by REESE’S?


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the concert[here](https://www.siriusxm.com/alexwarrennyctixPR) .


For fans who don’t live in the New York City area and still want to attend, you can also enter for a chance to win a VIP trip to the concert[here](https://www.siriusxm.com/alexwarrennyctripPR) .


### Listen to Alex Warren’s *Small Stage Series* Concert


Hear the concert on SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2)


- **Thursday, December 17:** 6pm ET
- **Friday, December 18:** 8pm ET
- **Saturday, December 19:** 4pm ET
- **Sunday, December 20:** 9am ET


Starting Friday, December 18, select songs will also air on[The Pulse (Ch. 5)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-pulse) ,[Mosaic (Ch. 305)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/mosaic) ,[Unwell Music (Ch. 3)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/unwell-music) , and[The Coffee House (Ch. 17)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-coffee-house) .


The full concert will also be available anytime on the[SiriusXM app](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/alex-warren) .
